provenance-final.evidenceText:
Evidence & limitations
Historical predictive associations are not causal effects or guaranteed future performance.
Validated prediction intervals are unavailable for this bounded backtest; point predictions carry unquantified uncertainty.
Saved observations end at 2026-09-30; predictions start after that cutoff, rather than assuming data reaches the report request date 2026-10-18.
Synthetic retail data supports implementation evaluation, not a claim of real-world forecasting reliability.
Grouped rates and averages are not averaged into population-wide ratios without their original denominators; request a source-calculated overall ratio when needed.

server_log_latency_observation.note: Read-only request-log samples from the new API revision. No exact distributed trace attribution; client/browser outlier remains in the sample.

limitations: Emulated desktop/mobile widths; no physical keyboard, microphone, complete screen-reader, contrast or 200% zoom certification.

Ten warm samples are a small observational comparison; chart-data response is not first paint or a guaranteed speedup. One retained candidate chart-data outlier increases browser p95 from 1.65s to 4.52s despite a lower median.
Report/chart tests reused immutable saved evidence; no fresh analytical/model, TimesFM, scenario, dashboard-builder or forecast-plan worker execution.
Five BigQuery tables were compared by row/byte/schema/modification metadata; no content scans or PostgreSQL customer recount.

An initial scenario chart wait used a scroll offset before the actual chart; explicit section/placeholder navigation passed. Dropdown checks required waiting for transition completion; stale snapshot references were not counted as product failures.
